body.p: Response to CTEQ dated August 7, 2024 Appl. Ser. No. 17/932_215
Claims 1-20 are pending. Claims 1, 3-6, 8, 14, 15, and 17-20 have been amended. No new matter is introduced. Reconsideration and allowance of the claims is respectfully requested.

Claims 1, 3-6, 8, 14, 15, and 17-20 have been amended as set forth above to correct the antecedence issues arising from the language of the claims as originally filed. Applicant would like to thank the Examiner for suggesting the amendments to overcome the issues. In view of the amendments, the antecedence issues outlined in the Ex-Parte Quayle Actions stand addressed. Reconsideration and withdrawal of the objections is respectfully requested.

The undersigned authorizes the charging of any necessary fees, including any extensions of time fees required to place the application in condition for allowance by Examiner's Amendment, to Deposit Account No. 50-0749 in order to maintain pendency of this application.

Applicant respectfully submits that the application is in condition for allowance, and respectfully requests an early and favorable action by the Examiner. If the Examiner believes that a telephone conversation with Applicant's attorney would expedite prosecution of this application, the Examiner is cordially invited to call Mr. Shyamal Kishore on the phone number of the attorney of record.
